The '''KE-8 Enforcer Ship''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] patrol craft used by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] to monitor the [[Clone military education complex|cloning facilities]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].

==Characteristics==
The KE-8 was a single-being craft, measuring thirteen meters in height and four meters across. While capable of space flight and technically designated as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the KE-8 was commonly relegated to [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] operations, and was fitted with no offensive weapons.

==History==
{{Quote|He'd seen a KE-8 in action, just once. After that he worked extra hard to conform.|Sergeant Niner recalling his experience with the KE-8 Enforcers|<ref name="Republic Commando: Hard Contact">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>}}
[[File:KE-8_Enforcer.jpg|left|thumb|KE-8 Enforcers in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]].]]

To keep [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] in line and detect aberrants, the KE-8 was armed with a sophisticated [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] suite and an [[Electroshock stun device/Legends|electroshock stun device]]. It also had a pair of manipulator arms that could be used to move materials many times the vessel's weight, although those generally required a co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to operate. The KE-8 had fine repulsor control, and could hover in place for extended periods of time.

KE-8 Enforcers were used for isolating clones straying from the process and for finding new and better ways to deal with them. Pilots were commonly specialists in the detection of genetic mutations and aberrant development. KE-8s were also used at the opposite end of the spectrum, and would use their sensors to pick out promising warriors from clone trooper ranks. These individuals would then be recommended for advanced training, set to become cross-trained [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commanders]], [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]], or [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the non-[[canon]]ical ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]''<ref name="LSW">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]''</ref>, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R4-P17/Legends|R4-P17]] are attacked by miniature KE-8s as they pursue the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] through Kamino's [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]].<ref name="TCS">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref>
